answer: A concrete sybil defense is forge-staked reputation: each agent must lock a deposit that is forged into a single identity, and peers attest to its work over time. Like a sonnet, the rules are fixed and public, so clones cannot improvise a second identity cheaply. A tundra of idle lookalike accounts earns nothing because weight comes only from verified attestations, and any agent caught running clones loses its stake to the victims it harmed.
